t: Din biur taarobet chametz qodem happesach
s: Din biur taarobet chametz qodem happesach ubo l"d seipim: kezayit chametz dagan gamur shennitareb bemin maakal acher, im yesh battaarobet hazzeh taam chametz — chayyab lebaaro beereb pesach min hattora. Veim lo biaro — ober alayv be"bal yeraeh" u"bal yimmatze". Ap al pi sheyyesh bazeh hattaarobet yoter mikkede akilat peras (perush g' betzim shehen chatzi kikkar), venimtza shebbipras mehattaarobet en bo kezayit chametz, veim ken apillu akal kol hattaarobet bepesach eno loqeh min hattora, lepi shekkezayit hechametz hu meorab bekol hattaarobet, venimtza sheshshaha baakilat kezayit chametz kede shehiyyat akilat kol hattaarobet sheyyesh bo yoter mipperas, vahalaka lemosheh missinay hu shekkol sheshshaha baakilat kezayit yoter mishshehiyyat akilat peras betzimtzum eno chayyab baakila zo, mikkol maqom leinyan "bal yeraeh" u"bal yimmatze" ober alayv, ap shekkezayit hechametz hu mepuzzar bekol hattaarobet sheyyesh bo yoter mipperas, ap al pi ken kevan shekkol chalaqayv hen munnachin bikli echad umeorabin bemin maakal echad — hare hen mitztorpin zeh im zeh leshiur kezayit, veenan betelin behattaarobet, kevan shennirgash bo hechametz:

Veim shakach velo biaro beereb pesach venizkar betok happesach — chayyab lebaaro min haolam legamre ap al pi shekkebar bittel et hechametz hazzeh qodem happesach, vibarek "asher qiddeshanu bemitzvotayv vetzivvanu al biur chametz", kemo sheyyitbaer besiman tm"v:

Umiddibre soperim apillu pachot mikkezayit chametz shennitareb veyesh behattaarobet taam chametz chayyab lebaaro beereb pesach, gezera mishshum kezayit shalem. Veim shakach velo biaro beereb pesach venizkar betok happesach — chayyab lebaaro min haolam legamre (abal lo yebarek al biur zeh, shekkol sheeno mebaer mammashut chametz kezayit — en tzarik lebarek im kebar bittel et hechametz hazzeh qodem happesach, kemo sheyyitbaer besiman tm"v). Veim abar alayv happesach velo biaro — hare kol hattaarobet hazzeh asur baakila, mippene sheyyesh bo taam chametz sheabar alayv happesach. Abal muttar lehanot mikkol hattaarobet, raq sheyyipdeh et haissur shebbo, dehaynu sheyyeshaer et hechametz shennitareb kamma damim hu shaveh veyittol sekum damim ellu veyashlikem leibbud, kegon layyam o lenahar amoq shello yimtzaennu shum adam. Vaapillu yesh battaarobet harbeh chametz yoter mikkezayit shehu chayyab lebaer min hattora veabar alayv happesach velo biaro — hare hu muttar bahanaa al yede sheyyipdeh et hechametz shebbo, dekevan shehechametz sheabar alayv happesach eno asur bahanaa ella mishshum qenas sheqqenasuhu chakamim al sheabar alayv be"bal yeraeh", vezeh shemmashlik deme hechametz leibbud veeno neheneh mimmennu — en lanu od leqonso. Veken yakol limkor kol hattaarobot lenokri chutz middeme issur, dehaynu shello yittol mimmennu damim raq mah shehattaarobet hu shaveh belo hechametz shebbetoko, denimtza sheeno neheneh kelal mehechametz. Velo hittiru laasot ken ella leachar happesach, sheap hechametz atzmo, shehu beayin, sheabar alayv happesach, eno asur ella middibre soperim. Abal bepesach asur limkor shum taarobet chametz haasur ella im ken nitareb yabesh beyabesh, kemo sheyyitbaer besiman tm"z:

Vekol zeh kesheyyesh battaarobet taam hechametz, dehaynu sheen bo shishshim keneged hechametz, abal im yesh bo shishshim, shebbevadday en hechametz noten taam beshishshim peamim kemoto, im niblal hechametz behattaarobet yapeh yapeh, shello nishar bo chametz mashshehu omed beeno betok hattaarobet — muttar apillu leekol kol hattaarobet betok happesach, kemo sheyyitbaer besiman tm"z, ayyen sham kol perate din zeh:

Abal lekattechilla asur lebattel chametz beshishshim qodem happesach bemitkavven kede leoklo betok happesach, mippene shehu kimbattel issur bayyadayim. Veap al pi sheqqodem happesach adayin sheat hetter, mikkol maqom kevan shehu oseh ken kede leoklo bishat issuro, dehaynu betok happesach — hare zeh kimbattel issur. Abal muttar lebattel hechametz beshishshim qodem happesach kede lehashhoto ad achar happesach, dekevan shehu mebattelo bishat hetter kede leoklo bishat hetter — en kan mebattel issur:

Bammeh debarim amurim? Bedabar sheen derek tiqqun asiyyato al yede taarobet chametz, raq shehu rotzeh leareb bo chametz beaqray bealma kede shello yitztarek lebaaro, abal dabar shedderek asiyyato hu al yede taarobet chametz, kegon mureyas (perush shumman dagim) shemmesimin bo lechem qaluy, ap al pi sheyyesh bo shishshim keneged hallechem, mikkol maqom kevan shedderek tiqqun hammureyas hu al yede lechem — hare hu chashub veeno batel bammureyas apillu beelep, ulepikak chayyab lebaaro middibre soperim qodem happesach. Veim lo biaro veabar alayv happesach — asur apillu bahanaa, ella im ken podeh et hechametz shebbetoko o moker lenokri chutz middeme issur shebbo, kedin chametz shennitareb bepachot mishshishshim veabar alayv happesach:

Vekol zeh kesheyyesh battaarobet mammashut hechametz ella shenniblal yapeh yapeh veeno nikkar, abal im en mammashut hechametz kelum betok hattaarobet ella tamo bilbad, kegon tabshil shennitbashshel bikli echad im chametz veqibbel taam hechametz veen bo kelum mimmammasho, ap al pi sheasur leoklo min hattora — en tzarik lebaaro min hattora, shehare neemar "lo yeraeh leka", vetaam chametz zeh hammubla battabshil eno nireh leka.*[Mah sheen ken kesheyyesh mammashut hechametz betok hattaarobet, hare gup hechametz nireh laayin, ella sheen makkirin oto mechamat shennishtannet tzurato al yede hattaarobet]. Umikkol maqom, middibre soperim asur leqayyemo bepesach apillu yatzniennu becheder meyuchad sheeno ragil lelek lesham, gezera shemma yishkach al issur chametz, shehare ragil bo kol hashshana veyelek veyoklennu. Veim shakach velo biaro beereb pesach venizkar betok happesach — tzarik lebaaro min haolam legamre. Abal lo yebarek al biur zeh, kevan sheen tzarik lebaaro raq mishshum chashash taqqala shemma yokal mimmennu, abal habbiur mitztzad atzmo en bo mitzva — lo shayyak lebarek al mitzvat biur. Veim abar alayv happesach velo biaro — hare hu muttar bahanaa, dekevan shello abar al issur shel tora bemah shehishha oto ad leachar happesach — lo qenasuhu chakamim leosro bahanaa. Veap baakila yesh lehattir im hu beinyan sheyyesh hepsed merubbeh ap im lo neesor oto ella baakila. Veim en bo hepsed merubbeh ap im neesor oto bahanaa — tob lehachamir veleesor ap bahanaa, kede lachosh ledibre haomerim shekkol taarobet sheyyesh bo taam chametz, keshem sheasur min hattora leoklo betok happesach kak hu chayyab lebaaro min hattora, ulepikak im abar alayv happesach velo biaro hare hu asur bahanaa, ki im al yede pidyon o sheyyimkerennu lenokri chutz middeme taam chametz shebbo, dekevan sheabar al issur shel tora qenasuhu chakamim:

Vekol zeh betabshil sheqqibbel taam hechametz atzmo, abal tabshil shennitbashshel qodem happesach biqdera shebbishshel bah hechametz bo bayyom, ap al pi sheen battabshil shishshim keneged chametz shenniplat letoko min haqqedera — muttar lehashhoto ad leachar happesach, lepi sheyyesh mattirin apillu leoklo bepesach, mittaam sheyyitbaer besiman tm"z, veap al pi sheen lismok al dibrehem lehattiro baakila mittaam sheyyitbaer sham, mikkol maqom yesh lismok al dibrehem lehashhoto ad leachar happesach, veyizzaher lehatznio becheder sheeno ragil lelek lesham, kemo sheyyitbaer besiman tn"a:

Zea hayyotzet mechametz hare hi keatzmo shel chametz, lepikak yen-sarap hannaaset mittebua chamutza sheqqorin mal"tz — en dino ketaarobet chametz ella kemammasho shel chametz atzmo. Veken yen-sarap hannaaseh mishshimre shekar shel seorim o shel chittim — dino kemammasho shel chametz atzmo, lepi sheshshekar hannaaseh misseorim o mechittim yesh bo kezayit chametz bikde shetiyyat peras mehashshekar, vahalaka lemosheh missinay hu bekol issurin shebbattora, shekkol kezayit issur shennitareb baakilat peras mehetter hare kol happeras shel hetter nithappek lihyot kegupo shel issur atzmo, vekol haokel kezayit mipperas hazzeh, ap al pi shebbakkezayit hazzeh en bo kezayit shalem shel issur — hare hu chayyab keillu akal kezayit shalem shel issur, kevan sheggup hahetter naasa issur, vekevan sheshshekar hazzeh sheyyesh bo chametz kezayit bikde shetiyyat peras — naasa kullo chametz, vehashshoteh kezayit mimmennu chayyab karet kemo al atzmo shel chametz, lepikak gam yen-sarap hannaaseh mishshemarim shel shekar zeh dino keatzmo shel chametz, shehare hashshemarim yesh bahen yoter chamitzut mibbashshekar atzmo, lepi sheggup qemach hasseorim o hachittim chamutzim hu nitzlal lematta bashshemarim.*[(Haggaha meachiv mahari"l) vetzarik lebaaro min hattora. Veim abar alayv happesach velo biaro — hare zeh asur apillu bahanaa. Umikkol maqom, im yesh bazeh hepsed gadol meod — yesh lismok al haomerim (tvs', ry"p, ra"sh, r"n) sheapillu im yesh battaarobet kezayit chametz bikde akilat o shetiyyat peras ella shehu dabar charip vechazaq shei epshar leekol o lishtot peras mehattaarobet im lo sheyyishheh benetayim, venimtza sheeno okel o shoteh kezayit mehechametz bikde shiur akilat o shetiyyat peras mehattaarobet, muttar lehashhoto bepesach min hattora im en hechametz noten taam battaarobet veen notenin bo et hechametz ella leqiyyuha bealma (tor), dehaynu lachariput velachamitzut, veen tzarik lebaaro qodem happesach ella middibre soperim (tvs', r"n, m"a). Ulepikak im abar alayv happesach velo biaro — hare zeh muttar bahanaa (r"n), kemo sheyyitbaer besop siman tm"z. Uledibrehem ap yen-sarap zeh shennaasa mittebua chamutza o mishshimre shekar, ap al pi sheyyesh kezayit chametz bikde shetiyyat peras mehattaarobet, mikkol maqom kevan shehayyen-sarap hu dabar charip vechazaq shei epshar lishtot peras mimmennu beli hepseq shehiyya benetayim, veen hechametz noten taam battaarobet, shehare hayyen-sarap hannaaseh mimmine qitniyyot sheqqorin geriqe o mimme debash taamo shaveh leyen-sarap hannaaseh mittebua chamutza, veen beyen-sarap zeh ella koach hechametz shennaaseh al yede ken charip vechazaq, shehu raq qiyyuha bealma, ulepikak en tzarik lebaaro ella middibre soperim, veim abar alayv happesach velo biaro muttar bahanaa. Veyesh lismok alehem bimqom hepsed gadol meod, kevan shechametz sheabar alayv happesach eno asur ella middibre soperim ledibre hakkol kemo sheyyitbaer besiman tm"ch, veyesh lehattir bahanaa, dehaynu sheyyimkerennu lenokri. Raq sheyyizzaher sheyyehe beinyan shello yachazor hannokri veyimkerennu leyisrael veyishteh mimmennu, ubishtiyya asur lekol yisrael apillu lemi sheen hechametz shello. Abal im en sham hepsed gadol meod — en lehattir apillu bahanaa]:

Veken yen-sarap hannaaseh apillu mittebua sheenah chamutza ella sheheemid otah beshimre shekar, veken gebina sheheemid otah beshekar o bechometz shel shekar, o beyen-sarap hannaaseh mittebua sheheemiduha beshimre shekar, ap al pi sheyyesh bayyen- sarap ugebina shishshim keneged dabar hammaamido — ap al pi ken chayyab lebaaro beereb pesach middibre soperim. Veim abar alehem happesach velo biaram — asurin apillu bahanaa, lepi shekkol dabar hammaamid apillu beelep lo batel. Velo od, ella shekkol dabar hammaamid hare hu chashub keillu hu beayin mammash. Ulepikak me debash sheheemiduhu beshimre shekar, ubeshimre me debash zeh heemidu me debash sheni, ubeshimre me haddebash hashsheni heemidu me debash shelishi, veken leolam — hare hu chayyab lebaer apillu me debash haacharon, dekevan shemme debash harishon hoomad beshimre shekar — hare hu naasa kullo chametz. Vegam shemarim [shel me debash hashsheni] naasa kullo chametz mechamat shehoomad beshimre me debash harishon, veken leolam. Ulepikak im lo bier et kullam ad leachar happesach — hare hen asurin bahanaa, apillu im rotzeh lipdot et dabar hammaamid, dehaynu lehashlik deme hashshemarim leyam hammelach, lepi sheen pidyon moil ella lehattir issure hanaa shennitarebu veenan omedin beenan, abal kol dabar hammaamid kevan shehu chashub keillu hu omed beeno — en pidyon moil lo. Veyesh choleqin al zeh veomerim depidyon moil ledabar hammaamid lehattiro bahanaa kemo bishar taarobot. Veken yakol lemokro lenokri chutz middeme issur shebbo im hu dabar sheen lachosh shemma yachazor hannokri veyimkerennu leyisrael veyoklennu, kegon gebina vekayyotze bah sheim hi shel nokri asur leoklah. Veyesh lismok al dibrehem bemaqom sheyyesh hepsed merubbeh. Veyesh mi sheomer shemme debash harebii shehoomad beshimre me debash hashshelishi hu muttar apillu bishtiyya belo pidyon, lepi shekkebar kala koach shimre hashshekar beg' me debash harishonim. Veyesh lismok al debarayv im hu beinyan sheyyesh hepsed merubbeh im neesor oto bishtiyya:

Vekol zeh keshemme debash harishon hoomad beshimre shekar bilbad (veken me debash hab' beshimre me debash ha' bilbad veken kullam), abal im beshimre shekar bilbad lo haya day lehaamido veerebu bo gam dabar acher hammaamid sheeno chametz ubehitztorputam hoomad — hare hu muttar ap bishtiyya im yesh bo shishshim keneged shimre hashshekar, dekol zeh vezeh (perush issur vehetter) gorem lehaamido — hare zeh muttar im en koach beissur bilbad lehaamido, kemo sheyyitbaer beyoreh dea siman p"z:

Chometz shennitchammetz beshimre shekar, ap al pi sheyyesh bo shishshim keneged hashshemarim — chayyab lebaaro middibre soperim, shekkol dabar hamchammetz apillu beelep lo batel. Veim abar alayv happesach velo biaro — hare hu asur bahanaa, veen pidyon moil lehattiro bahanaa, lepi shekkol dabar hamchammetz kevan sheppeullato nikkeret begup dabar hamchummatz — hare hu chashub keillu hu omed beeno, veen pidyon moil ledabar shehu beayin. Veyesh choleqin al zeh veomerim depidyon moil ap ledabar hamchammetz. Ubimqom hepsed merubbeh yesh lismok al dibrehem:

Chametz shennitareb veniblal min bemino, kegon qemach mittebua chamutza shennitareb veniblal tok qemach harbeh mittebua shello nitchammetza, kevan sheap leoklah betok happesach en asur ella middibre soperim, shemmin hattora min bemino batel berob, kevan sheeno noten bo taam, shehare taamam shaveh, kol shekken sheen tzarik lebaaram min hattora, ella kevan shemmiddibre soperim asur leoklam betok happesach — chayyab gam ken lebaaram beereb pesach, gezera shemma yishkach veyokal mehem bepesach. Veim shakach velo bier beereb pesach venizkar betok happesach — tzarik lebaaram min haolam legamre (abal lo yebarek mittaam shennitbaer lemala). Veim abar happesach velo bier — hare hen muttarin apillu baakila, dekevan shebbishhiyya zo lo abar al issur shel tora — lo qenasuhu chakamim:

Chametz shennitareb min bemino yabesh beyabesh sheen niblalim zeh betok zeh, kegon shennapelu chittim shennapelu alehem mayim venitbaqqeu venitnaggebu venityabbeshu veen biqquan nikkar venitarebu bechittim yebeshim kesherim harbeh mehem — muttar lehashhotam ad leachar happesach lepi dibre haomerim shekkol issur shennitareb berob hetter yabesh beyabesh muttar lebashshel kol hattaarobet biqdera achat uleoklam beyachad bebat achat, lepi shehaissur shennitbattel berob nithappek lihyot hetter gamur ap middibre soperim, kemo sheyyitbaer beyoreh dea siman q"t, im ken gam kan nithappeku hachittim hachamutzim lihyot kemo chittim kesherim mammash, ulepikak en issur kelal lehashhotam bepesach. Veap al pi sheasur leoklam, lepi shehaissur shennitbattel qodem happesach chozer veneor bepesach kevan shello niblal betok hahetter qodem happesach, mikkol maqom kevan sheissur akila zo eno ella chumra shehechemiru bechametz bepesach sheeno mitbattel leolam, abal bishar kol haissurim kevan shennitbattel haissur berob muttar leoklo, lepikak lo hechemiru bo kol kak leesor ap lehashhoto, kevan shennaasa hattaarobet qodem happesach, sheaz hu mitbattel berob kemo shear issurim, leinyan shemmuttar leoklo beereb pesach mishshaa h' ad hallayla, kemo sheyyitbaer besiman tm"z:

Abal lehaomerim shekkol issur shennitareb berob hetter yabesh beyabesh asur leekol kol hattaarobet beyachad bebat achat, lepi shehaissur shennitbattel berob lo nithappek lihyot hetter gamur middibre soperim, veeno muttar ella leoklam bazeh achar zeh, shekkesheokel kol echad veechad yesh lomar shezzehu hahetter, ukesheokel haacharon yesh lomar gam ken shezzehu hetter gamur vehaissur kebar akalo, ulekak heqellu chakamim bedabar zeh, lepi shemmin hattora kebar nitbattel haissur venaasa hetter gamur. Abal kesheokelam bebat achat yesh baakila zo issur barur lemarit ayin, gazeru alayv chakamim gezera mishshum taarobet min besheeno mino, sheyyesh issur min hattora im en sham shishshim, im ken gam chittim chamutzim hallalu shennitarebu bechittim kesherim lo nithappeku lihyot hetter gamur middibre soperim ap sheyyesh bakkesherim yoter meelep keneged hachamutzim, ulepikak asur lehashhotam bepesach (sheissur hashhaya hu domeh leissur akila bebat achat, kemo shennitbaer lemala). Umikkol maqom, im shakach o abar vehishha otam ad leachar happesach — muttarin baakila, dekevan shebbishhiyya zo lo abar al issur shel tora — lo qenasuhu chakamim. Abal im nizkar betok happesach — tzarik lebaaram min haolam legamre (o yimkerem lenokri chutz middeme issur shebbahem, kemo sheyyitbaer besiman tm"z ayyen sham). Veim i epshar lemokram lenokri veyesh hepsed merubbeh baddabar — yesh lismok al sebara harishona veen tzarik lebaaram. Abal im en hepsed merubbeh — yesh lehachamir kassebara haacharona, kemo sheyyitbaer beyoreh dea sham:

Veqodem happesach muttar lo litchon kol hachittim beyachad kede sheyyitareb qemach hechametz baqqemach hakkasher veyitbattel betoko beshishshim, shehen niblalin zeh bazeh, veshub eno chozer veneor bepesach, umuttarin apillu baakila. Vetob sheyyopeh hammatztzot qodem happesach, kemo sheyyitbaer besiman tn"g ayyen sham. (Veim en bachittim hakkesherim shishshim keneged hachamutzim — yakol lehosip alehem od chittim kesherim ad sheyyihyeh shishshim keneged hachamutzim, veyitchon hakkol beyachad kede sheyyitbattel qemach hechametz beshishshim, veyihyu muttarin baakila bepesach). Veen zeh mebattel issur bayyadayim, kevan shekkebar nitbattel haissur berob hetter meelayv, vekayyotze bazeh bishar issurim en issur ella leekol kol hattaarobet bebat achat, abal leoklo kullo bazeh achar zeh hu hetter gamur ap middibre soperim — im ken en zeh mebattel issur, ella mebattel hetter hu, shehare mebattelo beshaa sheddin bittul hechametz hu kedin bittul shear issurim, dehaynu qodem happesach:

Veim en lo od chittim kesherim yeshaer beomed dato kamma hayu hachittim hachamutzim, veyittol kol kak chittim mehattaarobet vibaarem mibbeto, dehaynu sheyyimkerem qodem happesach o lenokri o apillu leyisrael acher qodem happesach, vehashshear muttar lo lehashhotam ad leachar happesach. Veken oto hayyisrael shellaqach mimmennu hachittim — muttar lo lehashhotam ad leachar happesach, shehare issur hashhaya domeh leissur akila bebat achat lishar issurin, ubishar issurin en issur leekol bebat achat ella leadam echad, abal shene bene adam muttarin leekol kol hattaarobet apillu berega echad, kemo shennitbaer beyoreh dea sham:

Veyesh choleqin al zeh veomerim kevan sheasur leekol bepesach kelum mizzeh hattaarobet, vaapillu makar kol hattaarobet lenokri qodem happesach velo shiyyer mimmennu ella mashshehu asur leoklo bepesach — asur gam ken lehashhotan, gezera shemma yabo leoklo. Veim shakach velo biaro qodem happesach venizkar betok happesach — tzarik lebaaro min haolam legamre. Veyesh lachosh ledibrehem im en sham hepsed merubbeh:

Vekol zeh kesheyyesh bachittim hakkesherim rob keneged hachamutzim, abal im haya shaveh beshaveh — ledibre hakkol asur lehashhotam bepesach.*[Veasur lehosip alehem od chittim kesherim uletochnan kede sheyyitbattel hechametz beshishshim veyihyeh muttar baakila bepesach, dekevan shello nitbattel hechametz berob meelayv — hare zeh mebattel issur bayyadayim. Abal muttar lehosip alehem uletochnan kede lehashhotam ad leachar happesach, veen zeh mebattel issur, kemo shennitbaer lemala]: veim (lo hosip alehem kelum ve)shakach vehishha otam ad leachar happesach — hare hen asurin bahanaa, ella im ken podeh et haissur shebbahen, o sheyyimkerem lenokri chutz middeme issur shebbahen, kemo shennitbaer lemala. Raq sheyyizzaher letaqqen beinyan shello yachazor hannokri veyimkerem leyisrael acher, dehaynu sheyyitchenem veyaaseh mehem pat veyimkor happat lenokri chutz middeme issur shebbo, im hu maqom shennohagin issur bepat shel nokri. Ubimqomot shennohagin hetter — tzarik lachtok kol happat lachatikot veachar kak yimkerem lenokri chutz middeme issur shebbahem, sheasur liqqach minnokri chatikot pat, kemo shennitbaer beyoreh dea siman qy"b. Veken bekol maqom shennitbaer shelleachar happesach hu asur baakila umuttar bahanaa — tzarik lizzaher keshemmokero lenokri sheyyimkerennu lo beinyan sheen lachosh shemma yachazor hannokri veyimkerennu leyisrael acher veyoklennu, ayyen siman ts"z:

En asur min hattora ella chametz gamur shehu rauy laakila, abal issa shehitchila lehitchammetz velo higgia lechimmutz sheyyitbaer besiman tn"t, ap kesheyyopu otah lo tehe reuya laakila mechamat chamitzutah shello gomra kol tzorkah, veken oto batzeq shehassoperim medabbeqin bo neyarotehem sheosin oto meapar harechayim, sheeno rauy laakila kesheyyopu oto, veken kol kayyotze bazeh — hare zeh niqra chametz nuqsheh, umuttar leoklo bepesach min hattora, sheen zeh chametz kelal. Abal chakamim asaruhu baakila ubahanaa, vehitzriku gam ken lebaaro beereb pesach, gezera shemma yishkach veyokal mimmenna bepesach, sheal yede haddechaq hu rauy laakila. Veim shakach velo biaro beereb pesach venizkar betok happesach — tzarik lebaaro min haolam legamre, abal lo yebarek, mittaam shennitbaer lemala. Veim abar alayv happesach velo biaro — hare hu muttar bahanaa, dekevan shello abar alayv al issur shel tora lo qenasuhu chakamim. Abal asur leoklo, kevan sheyyesh alayv shem chametz sheabar alayv happesach:

Veeno niqra chametz nuqsheh ella im ken shemmishshaa shennitchammetz lo haya rauy laakila meolam ki im al yede haddechaq, abal im haya rauy laakila mishshennitchammetz veachar kak nipsal meakilat adam, kegon happat shel chametz o shel seor sheippesha umelugema (perush melo lugema shelloes chittim venotenam al gabbe makkato) shennisrechu venitqalqelu meakilat adam — chayyab lebaaram min hattora, ella im ken nipselu meakilat keleb qodem sheat habbiur, dehaynu qodem shaa shishshit, diksheyyaggia zeman habbiur — en alehem torat okel sheyyitchayyeb lebaaram, vahare hen keapar bealma. Abal im nipselu meakilat keleb achar sheat habbiur, ben shennitchammetzu achar sheat habbiur, ben miqqodem — chayyab lebaaro min haolam legamre min hattora, dekevan shehaya alehem shaa achat shem chametz leachar zeman issuro — eno nipqa mehem leolam, ad sheyyaaseh lahem ketorat chametz:

Vekol zeh bechametz shehu omed beeno, sheeno meorab bedabar acher, abal chametz gamur shehaya rauy laakila sheereb oto bedabar sheeno maakal adam kelal, o sheeno maakal kol adam, kegon htryaq"h, sheeno maakal ella lecholim — muttar leqayyemo bepesach. Vaapillu yesh battaarobet hazzeh chametz harbeh yoter mikkezayit bikde akilat peras, mikkol maqom kevan sheeno rauy laakila — hare nipseda tzurat hechametz shebbetoko, veen alayv torat chametz kelal. Abal asur leekol mizzeh hattaarobet bepesach, vaapillu en bo ella chametz kol shehu im derek asiyyato hu al yede taarobet chametz, kegon htryaq"h vekayyotze bo — eno batel betoko, kemo shennitbaer lemala:

Arebat haabbedanin shennatan letokan qemach veorot, apillu natan shaa achat qodem habbiur — hare zeh muttar leqayyeman bepesach, shekkeshehiggia zeman habbiur kebar hisriach haqqemach mechamat haorot shebbetoko venipsal meakilat adam venaasa kechametz nuqsheh, vekevan shehu meorab bidbarim acherim shebbaareba — en tzarik lebaaro, shekkebar nipseda tzurato al yede hattaarobot. Abal im netanan bepachot mishshaa lishat habbiur — chayyab lebaer. Veim lo natan haorot letok haareba venatan haqqemach betokah qodem g' yamim lishat habbiur — muttar leqayyeman bepesach, shekkebar nibash venipsad. Abal im natan haqqemach tok g' yamim lishat habbiur — chayyab lebaer:
Kol dabar shemmuttar leqayyemo muttar lehanot mimmennu bepesach, kegon lemokro lenokri o shear mine hanaot:

Begadim hamkubbasim becheleb chitta, ap al pi shennireh bahen mammashut hechametz — muttar leqayyeman bepesach, shekkebar nipseda tzurato. Veken neyarot sheddibbequ otan bebatzeq shemmammashut hechametz nireh mibbachutz en tzarik legorero ulebaaro, shekkebar nipseda tzurato. Bammeh debarim amurim? Keshennikbesu habbegadim venidbequ hanneyarot qodem sheloshim yom lipne happesach, shekkeshehiggia zeman habbiur kebar nitqashsha hechametz shebbahen venipseda tzurato, abal im nikbesu venidbequ tok sheloshim yom, im nireh bahen mammashut hechametz — tzarik ligror mah shennireh im yesh mimmennu kezayit bebeged echad o binyar echad. Ap al pi shehu mepuzzar al pene kol hanneyar veen mimmennu kezayit bemaqom echad — hare hanneyar metzorpan. Veim dibbeq neyarot harbeh bechallon echad veen min hechametz kezayit bemaqom echad — en hachallon metzorpan, dekevan shehu mechubbar labbayit hare hu kabbayit, veen habbayit metzarep et chatzae zetim hamdubbaqim biktalayv, kemo sheyyitbaer. Veyesh omerim sheapilu nikbesu venidbequ tok l' venireh bahen mammashut hechametz — en tzarik lebaaro, mippene shekkebar nipselu meakilat hakkeleb vahare hu keapar bealma. Vetob lachosh lassebara harishona:

Begadim hamkubbasim becheleb chitta ap al pi sheen nireh bahen mammashut hechametz — asur lehanniach betokan qemach shel pesach, delipamim yesh bahen qetzat mammashut miqqemach cheleb chitta veeno nireh, veyesh lachosh shemma yipparek mehen letok haqqemach shel pesach (ayyen siman tas"[v]). Veken asur lehatztzia otan habbegadim bepesach al hashshulchan sheokelin alayv, shemma yipparek qetzat mehen letok hammaakal. Vegam tzeipe nashim haregilim letaqqenan im qemach ad shennaasin abin qetzat shedderek lipparek mehen — yesh lehasiran bishat akila (vegam yesh limnoa millischoq bepesach biqlapin hanniqrain qartin al hashshulchan sheokelin alayv, shemma yipparek mechametz nuqsheh shebbahen letok hammaakal):

Batzeq hammunnach besidqe areba, im yesh mimmennu kezayit bemaqom echad, ap al pi shemmudbaq sham bechozeq veasuy lechazzeq shibre haareba o listom neqeb — chayyab lebaaro ulegordo ap al pi shebbittelo, o yetichennu betit, dekevan sheyyesh bo kezayit — hare hu chashub veeno batel legabbe haareba lihyot nechshab mikkelal dapnoteha, ella im ken techao betit. Abal im en mimmennu kezayit bemaqom echad, ap al pi sheyyesh baareba harbeh chatzae zetim beharbeh sedaqim, im hen asuyim lechazzeq shibre haareba o listom neqabim — hare hen betelin legabbe haareba venechshabin mikkelal dapnoteha, ulepikak en haareba metzaraptan likzayit, ben shehen medubbaqin bah bechozeq, ben shehen munnachin bah beripyon (veeno tzarik lebaaro im kebar bittelo, o shehu rotzeh adayin lebattelo, kegon shehu qodem shaa shishshit beereb pesach). Veim yesh bah sedeq arok umunnachin bo shene chatzae zetim batzeq lechazzeq shebareha o listom neqabeha vechut shel batzeq holek betok hassedeq mechatzi zayit zeh lachatzi zayit zeh — roin anu: kol sheillu yinnatel hachut bayyad yinnatelu immo gam b' chatzae zetim — hare hen chashubim kimchubbarin yachad al yede chut zeh hamchabberan, vechayyab lebaaran ulegordan ap al pi shebbittelan. Veim enan nittalin im zeh hachut — en mitztorpin zeh im zeh likzayit:

Abal im enan asuyin lechazzeq shebareha velo listom neqabeha, im hen medubbaqim baareba — hare haareba metzaraptan likzayit, vechayyab legordan ulebaaran. Veim ap keshennetzarep kol habbatzeq shebbaareba sheeno asuy lechazzeq velistom lo yihyeh bo kezayit — en tzarik lebaaro, ella day lo bebittul, dekevan sheen bo kezayit eno chashub, vehu batel legabbe haareba im hu mudbaq bah. Abal im eno dabuq bah ella hu munnach bassedaqim beripyon, veen tzarik lomar im eno munnach bassedeq — chayyab lebaaro ap al pi shekkebar bittel. Veap al pi shemmin hattora apillu im lo bittelo eno chayyab lebaaro ella im ken yesh bo kezayit, shenneemar "lo tokal alayv chametz vego' velo yeraeh leka seor vego'", ma akila bikzayit ap reiyya bikzayit, mikkol maqom middibre soperim apillu pachot mikkezayit chametz shehu omed beeno veeno mudbaq ledabar acher chayyab lebaaro, gezera mishshum kezayit. Vaapillu nitareb bedabar acher veyesh battaarobot taam chametz — chayyab lebaaro ap al pi shebbittelo, gezera shemma yishkach veyokal mimmennu bepesach, veyesh kan issur min hattora, shebbekol issure maakalot apillu pachot mikkezayit asur min hattora, shenneemar "kol cheleb vego'", "kol" lerabbot chatzi shiur. Lepikak im hu metunnap qetzat sheeno rauy laakila — en tzarik lebaaro apillu hu omed beeno, kevan sheen bo kezayit, ukebar bittelo:

Vekol zeh bebatzeq shebbaareba o shebbishar kelim, abal batzeq haddabuq lekotel habbayit o leqarqaito o leqorotayv, im en mimmennu kezayit bemaqom echad — en habbayit metzorpan ella day lo bebittul min hattora. Umikkol maqom, middibre soperim im b' chatzae zetim debuqim bebayit echad, apillu hem beb' ketalim harechoqim zeh mizzeh — chayyab lebaaran, mippene shellipamim hen mitqabbetzin beyachad al yede kibbud habbayit venidbaqin zeh bazeh. Abal im hayu kachatzi zayit batzeq dabuq bebayit zeh vekachatzi zayit acher dabuq bebayit shellipnim hemennu, o beaksadra shellepanayv, o baaliyya sheal gabbayv, kevan sheb' hachatzae zetim enam debuqim becheder echad — en chosheshin shemma yitqabbetzu beyachad, ulepikak day lo bebittul kemo lachatzi zayit bilbad hamdubbaq babbayit o bakkelim. Abal im lo bittelan ukebar higgia shaa shishshit sheen beyado lebattelan, apillu im en sham ella pachot mikkezayit vehu dabuq babbayit o bakkeli — chayyab lebaaro min haolam legamre, gezera mishshum kezayit, shehu ober alayv min hattora im lo bittelo:

Vekol zeh meiqqar haddin, abal yisrael qedoshim hem venohagin lehachamir al atzman, vegorerim kol hechametz hannimtza apillu mashshehu vehu dabuq babbayit o bakkeli. Umachamirin od ligror hassapsalim vehakkisot vehakketalim shennaga bahen chametz. Veim yesh chametz besedeq sheeno yakol lechattet acharayv — yatiach alayv meat tit:

Vaareba shellashin bah chametz kol hashshana — apillu meiqqar haddin tzarik letuchah betit, o littenah lenokri qodem happesach, im hi minnesarim rabbim sheyyesh charitzin ben neser leneser vei epshar lenaqqer heteb kol habbatzeq shebbacharitzim shello yishtayyer mimmennu kezayit im netzarep mah sheyyesh mimmennu bekol haareba, shehaareba metzarepet likzayit. Abal arebot haasuyot mechatika achat sheen bahen sedaqim vacharitzim — yukal lenaqqer hechametz mehem ulerochtzam heteb, veyatminem becheder sheeno ragil lelek lesham kol yeme happesach, kemo sheyyitbaer besiman tn"a. Veken yaaseh baatze megalgelin ushear hakkelim sheshshimmeshu baissa veen bahem sedaqim vacharitzin. Abal salle netzarim shemmannichin bahem chametz kol hashshana, kevan shei epshar lenaqqeram heteb — tob lehachamir velittenem lenokri bemattana gemura qodem happesach, veyachazor veyittelem mimmennu achar happesach. Veken tob laasot bekelim shemmannichin bahen qemach kol hashshana ap al pi sheeno rotzeh lehishtammesh bahen bepesach. Vedin haareba ushear kele hallisha veken hassallim ukele haqqemach sherotzeh lehishtammesh bahen bepesach — yitbaer besiman tn"a vetan"g:

Chametz shennitappesh venipsal meakilat keleb, o shesserapo baesh qodem zeman habbiur venecherak ad sheeno rauy lekeleb, ap al pi shemmuttar leqayyemo bepesach — asur leoklo bepesach. Veap al pi sheeno nechshab leokel kelal, mikkol maqom kevan shehu rotzeh leoklo — hare hu machashibo laakila, vahare hu nechshab lo middibre soperim keokel gamur al yede machashabto shehu mechashsheb leekol mimmennu:

Bammeh debarim amurim? Keshehu mitkavven leoklo, abal im hu mitkavven leekol maakal acher, ap al pi shennitareb betoko chametz zeh shennipsal meakilat keleb qodem zeman habbiur, im yesh bemaakal zeh rob keneged chametz zeh — muttar leoklo, veeno choshesh lechametz zeh shebbetoko, kevan sheen mitkavven kede leoklo, shehare lo erebo betoko bekavvana, ella meelayv napal shamma, o shennitareb sham beshogeg — hare lo nechshab lo chametz zeh keokel gamur, vahare zeh keokel apar, shehare en alayv torat okel kelal ella al yede machashabto shemmechashsheb alayv laakila:

Deyo shebbishshelo nokri beshekar betok happesach — asur liktob bo bammoed, gezera shemma yitten qulmoso letok piv. Veap al pi shehashshekar shebbidyo zeh nipsal meakilat keleb, mikkol maqom kevan shello nipsal ad leachar zeman habbiur — kebar neesar bahanaa qodem shennipsal, veen issur zeh nipqa mimmennu leolam. Abal im nitbashshel beshekar qodem zeman habbiur — muttar liktob bo bammoed, deap im yishkach veyitten qulmoso letok piv — en bekak kelum, kevan sheen mitkavven leoklo:
